lessons.title: Final review
lessons.objective: By the end of this lesson, you can explain Final review, write a small working example, and diagnose one common mistake.
lessons.explanation:
Final review is a practical part of the fullstack learning path. Focus on what problem it solves, how the main pieces connect, and how to verify your result.

How to learn it: first identify the input and expected output, then inspect the example line by line. Change one value yourself and run the result. Finally, explain why the output changed.

Common mistake: copying syntax without changing and testing the example. Verify your work with the browser, terminal, console, or API response instead of assuming it works.
